page.layout: One page of text in a single main column; marginal notes in the right margin. Running head at top centre, page number at top right. Verse lines and a heading "Lemnos insula maris Ægæi" in the column; notes listed down the right margin.

main_text.p: Lemnos: vbi ignisera sessus respirat ab Ætna Claud. in Rufinum lib. 1.
Vestit Athos, nemorumque obscurat imagine pontum.
Seu te cana gelu Rhodope, seu remige Medo Sollicitatus Athos, seu caligantia nigris.
Aut Athon, aut Rhodopen, aut alta Ceraunia telo Deijcit.
main_text.head: Lemnos insula maris Ægæi.
main_text.p: — Ægæo premitur circunslua Nereo Stat. Theb. lib. 5.
Lemnos: vbi ignisera sessus respirat ab Ætna
Vestit Athos, nemorumq; obscurat imagine pontum.

Thraces arant contrà. Thracum fatalia nobis Littora, & inde nefas: florebat diues alumnis Terra, nec illa Samo fama, Delo ve sonanti Peior, & innumeris quas spumifer assilit Ægon. Dis visum turbare domos: nec pectora culpa Lemnie mulieres in maritos suos coiurarunt, qui occiderunt.
Nostra vacant: nullos Veneri sacrauimus ignes, Nulla Deæ sedes. Mouet & cœlestia quondam Corda dolor, lentóque irrepunt agmine pœnæ.
Illa Paphon veterem, centúmque altaria linquens, Nec vultu, nec crine prior, soluisse iugalem Ceston, & Iliadas procul ablegasse volucres Fertur.
Hoc erat in gelido quare Paantius antro Philoctetes in Lemno relictus à Græcis. Trist lib. 5. Valer. lib. 2. Incendia in Lemno la frequentia.
Lemnos aquis, tibi per varios defleta labores Ignipotens: nec te Furiys, & crimine matrum, Terra, fuga meritiq, piget meminisse prioris, Tempore quo primum fremitus insurgere opertos

page.notes: Marginal notes on the right are partly damaged and abbreviated; the reading of the notes is approximate. Several words in the body are uncertain, notably "Mulciber", "Lemnie" and the Philoctetes note.
